name: Zebra crossing and beacon approach
observations: White zebra stripes span the roundabout approach with broken/zigzag lead-in markings.
Tall poles with yellow globe beacons stand on kerb edges.
Curved footways, double yellow lines, nearby bin and direction signs define approach.
Crossing is independent of GLO/Bistro storefronts and should remain readable at player height.
Use stock/simple props initially; exact pole spacing and stripe dimensions require calibration.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
